appUpdate.changelog:
• Supports both the old and new prebuilt songfile/IDX (old: 48,000 songs; new: 42,000 songs). Note: The prebuilt songfile/IDX is a sample set of songs provided by SongHub so the app is usable right away. Future song updates are not supported. Modifying or disassembling this songfile, using it in another karaoke application or project, selling it, or any other unauthorized use is strictly prohibited.
• Added Remote Server Host for browsers (good for iOS and other devices). The default port is 48081.
• Added export of the song list to CSV/XLS for use in Mega Karaoke Songbook and other applications.
• The recording function is now working. Type a number and press the Record button to start recording! Recordings are saved in SongHub > record.
• Enhanced Picture-in-Picture (PIP) mode. You can keep singing while using another app or scrolling through social media! (PIP does not work on Android 6 Marshmallow and Android 7 Nougat, since the PIP feature was only introduced in Android 8 Oreo.)
• MTV support in Karaoke mode! You can now play your favorite MTVs and downloaded YouTube karaoke videos by entering a code in Karaoke mode. Scoring, tempo and key is also supported. Just place it on SongHub > videos folder!
• You can now share your Top 3 Ranked Songs on any social media platform.
• Favorite Songs: Save your favorite songs! In the song, artist, or new song search, tap the heart icon on the right on any song you want to save. Then go to My Favorite Songs in the Main menu to browse them.
• MIDI support in ZIP files: Place your .ZIP file containing MIDI files in the SongHub > songs folder, and it will be registered and scanned automatically. No extraction needed. This is ideal for very large MIDI collections and saves storage space. Note: RAR, 7z, and password-protected ZIP files are not supported.
• Melody is now set to 0 (off) by default.
• Fanfare/Digit Sound settings are here! You can now change and customize the fanfare and digit sounds.
   ◦ When set to Custom, the app looks for and reads the following .mp3 files in the SongHub/assets folder:
   ◦ Digit Sounds: num_0.mp3 to num_9.mp3 (for number typing on the keypad).
   ◦ Fanfare Sounds: score_61_75.mp3, score_76_80.mp3, score_81_90.mp3, score_91_99.mp3, score_100.mp3 (for the score fanfare/sound effects after singing).
• Easy activation for Android/Google TV: If you have obtained the .lic file, you can export it to your USB drive or internal storage. No more hassle with typing or going to the TV browser. To activate with the .lic file, tap Enter Karaoke, tap the .LIC file button, and select the songhub-xxxxxxxxxx.LIC file. It activates instantly.
• Added Song Entry Overlay in Settings. You can change the "Select a Song" text and add bottom text for greetings. Font style and color can also be changed.
• Added Backup/Restore Configurations to keep your settings safe so they can be restored when needed.
